rules.statement: A mortgagee is not required to give notice under section 643 of the Civil Procedure Code if the claimant does not have a valid registrable document.
rules.supporting_quote: It is only a grantee, lessee, mortgagee, or other incumbrancer who claims an interest in land sought to be affected by an action under chapter XLVI. of the Civil Procedure Code on a valid registrable document who is entitled to the notice of action provided for by section 643 of the Code.
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: section 643 of the Civil Procedure Code

meta.parties: Mohideen Et Al v. Appuhamy Et Al
